description: This file defines the ApiClient class responsible for making HTTP requests (GET and POST) to a specified base URL, handling authorization tokens, and processing responses including error handling. It includes functionalities to build request headers, construct URIs, and decode responses, with custom exceptions for error cases.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A client class for making HTTP requests with automatic token handling, response decoding, and error mapping.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Generates HTTP headers including content type and optional authorization token.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Constructs a URI with the base URL, path, and optional query parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Sends an HTTP GET request to the given path with optional query parameters and returns the decoded response or throws an error.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Sends an HTTP POST request to the given path with an optional body, returning the decoded response or throwing an error.

methods.name: _handleResponse
methods.description: Handles the HTTP response by decoding JSON if successful, otherwise throws an appropriate exception.

methods.name: _mapError
methods.description: Maps HTTP status codes to specific application exceptions.
